reason: The README describes a DeepSeek Harness Web UI plugin whose primary purpose is visualizing precise cache-hit rates, token usage, context occupancy, and estimated session costs through a statistics line and usage panel.

summaries.zh: 在 DeepSeek Harness Web UI 中展示精确缓存命中率、分桶 token 用量、上下文占用和会话费用估算。
summaries.en: Displays precise cache-hit rates, token usage by bucket, context occupancy, and estimated session costs in the DeepSeek Harness Web UI.

capabilities: Reads session token usage, cache bucket counts, context pressure, model, timestamps, and assistant message history
Displays usage metrics and estimated session costs in the DeepSeek Harness Web UI
Modifies the web UI statistics line and adds a usage panel
Applies configured pricing and peak/off-peak rules to estimate costs
